description: Alterations including installation of external staircase to provide access to rear garden. Replacement of first floor rear window with door.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - By reason of the form, scale, siting and utilitarian appearance of the proposed external staircase and associated platform, the development would appear as an incongruous and visually intrusive addition that would fail to integrate sympathetically with the host. The proposal would therefore fail to achieve a high-quality design, contrary to Policies LP1 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 2 - By reason of its elevated position and relationship of the proposed first-floor platform and external staircase to the private rear amenity space serving neighbouring occupiers, the development would result in harmful noise, disturbance, overlooking and an overbearing presence, to the detriment of residential amenity of neighbouring properties. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
